config.authoring_guidance: Parts concatenate exactly with no implicit separators. Include the whitespace required for headings, paragraphs, tables and other Markdown at every part boundary; a new heading needs a preceding newline. Keep local caveats associated with the same option. Slot values already contain some units: show points/currency/unit labels once and preserve minor-unit qualifiers; never infer missing fees, quote scope or totals. Describe source carriers as reported carriers unless operating-carrier evidence is explicit. Use exact supplied claim-catalog proposition names where applicable, rather than inventing synonymous machine labels; do not force an inapplicable proposition. Briefly explain why each selected variant is useful and distinct without adding eligibility or valuation policy. Explain coverage limitations in plain language while retaining mandatory source-bound disclosures. You still own layout, ordering and prose.

## Coverage and exclusions

Coverage includes completed cash searches for SFO–BKK and SFO–LAX and completed award-detail searches for LAX–BKK. Direct SFO–BKK and SFO–TPE award searches returned no observations. Some additional award-detail searches for LAX–BKK and TPE–BKK were omitted after the resource budget was exhausted, so the observed options do not establish that no other routings exist. Provider search coverage is not a guarantee of availability or bookability.

Rejected candidates are excluded from recommendations. For example, a screened-out SFO–LAX connection had only 106 minutes, below the 120-minute separate-ticket minimum used in screening. The reported cash and award component dates are observations from different searches; recheck all components and schedules before relying on them.
disclosures: The component observations may have different observation or provider-update dates; timing and availability can change.
